description:
Put questions to ChatGPT, Gemini, AI Overviews, AI Mode, Perplexity or Copilot now, as a buyer in the workspace's market (or location, a country) asks them: whether the answer names or cites the brand and where, the rivals it names, the pages it cites. Answers vary run to run. Each answer is one of the month's AI answers (usage says what's left).
action:
- ask(question, engine, location?): One question to one AI model.
- batch(questions, engines, location?): Up to 20 questions in up to 6 AI models (60 answers at most), with a tally per AI model. Only answers that came back count.
- recheck(question, engine, days?): Ask now and again in days (7 when not given, 3 to 30), to see what a change did: two AI answers. get_prompts rechecks reads it.
- cancel_recheck(checkBackId): Call off a re-check that hasn't asked again yet.
name: ask_ai
title: Ask AI models now
